title: Fuzzy Purple Crop & Denim Maxi
prompt: An original young woman with long, wavy copper-red hair stands full-length against a white backdrop. She wears a fuzzy magenta-purple long-sleeve crop top with a sweetheart neckline, a sheer layer beneath, and a silver choker. A long vintage denim maxi skirt with frayed hem and a studded belt, plus a slouchy suede shoulder bag, complete the outfit. Plush purple slippers finish the look. Her expression is calm. Soft, even studio light. Palette of magenta, indigo denim, and burnt copper. Cozy and playful, in the style of a fall street-style lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The fuzzy texture and denim maxi are the defining pieces.
- Keep the slippers for a playful, lounge-inspired finish.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the slippers for a lounge-inspired finish.
